trial_court: Court of Sh. Sumit Dalal, District Judge - 04, South West District, Dwarka Courts : New Delhi
case_name: Satya Pal Singh And Anr vs Vishal Grewal And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sh. Satya Pal Singh and Smt. Santosh Devi (both R/o: C-6B/11, Janakpuri, New Delhi - 110058)
parties.respondent_defendant: Mr. Vishal Grewal and Ms. Akansha Rathi (R/o: H.No. C-6B/168, Third Floor, Janakpuri, New Delhi - 110058)

facts_of_case: The plaintiffs are elderly individuals who own and reside in the property bearing No. C-6B/168 in Janak Puri, New Delhi. The suit property specifically refers to the third floor of this building, which they rented out to the defendants in October 2020.

legal_principles.principle: The requirements of registration and the requirements of stamping operate in distinct legal spheres.
legal_principles.held: Whether or not a document requires compulsory registration is determined by the Registration Act, 1908, specifically Sections 17 and Section 107 of the Transfer of Property Act for leases.

legal_principles.principle: A settled principle of law is that the requirements of registration and the requirements of stamping operate in distinct legal spheres.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff has been granted a decree for permanent injunction and possession in respect of suit property bearing no. C-6B/168, third floor, Janakpuri, New Delhi - 110058.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for possession and recovery of rent
